# Community guidelines

Help make searchSDK a respectful place to contribute. Assume good intent, focus
feedback on the work, and explain disagreements with evidence. Welcome questions
and contributors with different backgrounds and levels of experience.

Harassment, discrimination, threats, sexualized conduct, sharing private
information, and sustained disruption are unacceptable in project spaces.

Maintainers may edit or remove content, close discussions, or restrict
participation to protect contributors and keep collaboration productive.

To report a public conduct issue, ask a maintainer to review it in the relevant
thread. For a sensitive concern, open an issue requesting a private contact
without naming affected people or disclosing personal details. Share those
details only through an agreed private channel.
